analysis_result.analysis: The model failed primarily due to perceptual hallucinations and misidentification of visual elements. The error originated in perception — the model either misinterpreted the visual sequence or fabricated elements — and cascaded into a counting error. No fundamental reasoning flaw exists beyond the misperception; the model applied consistent counting logic to its (incorrect) observations.
